question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4 **i.e. **Invoking'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** sentence discusses** how the Supreme Court can be approached by anyone or any group of people either by filing a Writ Petition or by addressing a letter to the Chief Justice of India.
 
• **In the context **of legal or formal procedures, the term "invoking" means to call upon or to appeal to a higher authority or principle for support.
 
• **When discussing the jurisdiction** of the Supreme Court or any legal entity, "invoking" implies making use of, or calling upon, the authority or power that the entity possesses.
 
• The other options provided don't fit logically within the context of the sentence and its legal implications.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Halting" **(रुकना) means causing to stop or pause. It doesn't make sense in the context of approaching the Supreme Court for its jurisdiction.
 
• **"Rocking"** (हिलाना) often refers to moving something back and forth or causing it to shake. It has no relation to the context of the sentence.
 
• **"Joking" **(मजाक करना) means to speak or act in jest or to be playful. It's completely irrelevant in a formal and serious context, such as the one described in the sentence.
